text: 52yo female admitted with community-acquired pneumonia. Past medical history: Type 2 Diabetes. Allergies: NKDA (No Known Drug Allergies). Home Meds: Metformin 500mg twice daily.
WBC: 14.2 x10^9/L (HIGH). Serum Creatinine: 0.9 mg/dL (NORMAL). Blood Glucose: 148 mg/dL.
Patient afebrile for 24 hours on IV Ceftriaxone and Azithromycin. Repeat WBC trending down to 9.4 x10^9/L (NORMAL). Tolerating oral diet.
Pneumonia resolved. Transitioned IV antibiotics to oral Azithromycin 500mg once daily for 2 more days. Resume home Metformin 500mg twice daily. Follow up with primary care in 7 days.
